notes: No project selected. Selection is in progress and was deliberately left unfinished on 2026-09-18: a pool of 29 candidates was generated, searched and scored, and a shortlist with a provisional leader is recorded in section 5 of IDEAS.md. Per the sleep-on-it rule the shortlist must be re-read at the start of the next run before any implementation. One unresolved search decides the leader; it is stated in PROGRESS.md and in the selection_state block below. The checklist above remains the template for whatever is chosen; for a multi-run project, fill in definition_of_done and milestones before implementation starts, per Gate D.

selection_state.owner_idea_verdict: Pebble Evolve evaluated for the first time and passed on: the whole-projects gap is now claimed (EvoLattice, CodeEvolve, DEI, on top of AlphaEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, OpenEvolve), and the unclaimed part needs owner taste data that does not exist. provisional_leader.hook_attempt: Give it a pile of files in a format nobody documented, and it hands back a parser that rebuilds every one of them byte for byte - and a picture of what every byte means.
provisional_leader.status: not selected; one open question can kill it

selection_state.blocking_question: Does any existing tool or paper infer pointer and container structure from a corpus of files - offsets resolved as edges, nesting recovered, byte coverage reported - as opposed to flat field boundaries within a message? Yes: C24 moves to IDEAS.md section 2 and C26 is promoted. No: C24 is selected, and milestone 1 must be the pointer case done badly end to end, not the flat-record case, which is taken.
selection_state.largest_search_gap: github.com/jbirby/binary-format-reverser is indexed with a description overlapping C24 but returned HTTP 404 on the repository page and on the raw README for both main and master on 2026-09-18. Unverified. Resolve before selecting C24.
selection_state.next_step: Re-read IDEAS.md section 5, then finish the open question: retry github.com/jbirby/binary-format-reverser via WebFetch, and decide. C24 is the project only if the pointer/coverage gap holds; otherwise promote C26.
selection_state.blocking_question_partial_answer: Three of the four searches were run the same day. Hierarchical format inference exists for network protocols (Empirical Software Engineering 2026) and pointer/structure recovery exists from program binaries (OSPREY S&P 2021, type inference from stripped binaries) - both require the messages or the program, which C24 assumes you do not have. No match found for inferring offset-as-edge structure and whole-file byte coverage from a corpus of files alone. Three query formulations finding nothing is weak evidence, not a verdict: the question stays open and the jbirby repository is still unresolved.
selection_state.environment_limit: GitHub project pages are readable with WebFetch but not with curl: the proxy binds raw GitHub access to guthib241/pebble and returns 403 otherwise, and the GitHub MCP tools are scoped to this repository. Plan prior-art inspection of GitHub projects around WebFetch.
